contexts.text: At the side were seen small mirrors... SE 4305.
Images and mirrors of heavenly things...
So that the things of Heaven appear as in a mirror...
Like an image in a mirror, which appears in the mirror...
With these there is no mirror from the interior, but only from the exterior.
It may be compared to a man who sees himself in a mirror...
All the truths of faith appeared (to the man of the Celestial Church) in his Intellectual as in a mirror.
With the regenerate, goods and truths are presented in the Natural as in a mirror... AC 5168:2. AC 5477:2.
Unless the exterior Natural served interior things as a plane, in which they see themselves as in a mirror, man could not think at all.

Scientifics are... as it were mirrors, in which an image of interior things presents itself; and, in this image, as again in a mirror, the truths and goods of faith present and represent themselves...
Like one who sees something in a mirror, and does not know that there is a mirror there...
The interior looks out in the exterior, almost as a man [looks at] himself in a mirror...
The face is so formed that the interiors appear in it, as in a representative mirror...
The Intellectual of these is illustrated, and is thus in a certain perception of spiritual truth, to which scientifics which are below serve as a mirror... AC 9394.
From these things it can be seen as in a mirror... For from the things which come forth in the natural world can be seen as in a mirror the things which are in the Spiritual World.
The infinite things in God Man appear in Heaven, etc., as in a mirror. DLW 22.
An Angel sees his image (in the things around him) scarcely otherwise than as in a mirror.
The Divine truths of the Word... are like mirrors in which the Lord's face is seen.
To (such) the Holy Scripture is like a mirror in which he sees God...

Knowledges about God are mirrors of God; and those who know nothing about God do not see God in any mirror turned to the eyes, but in a mirror at the back, which is covered with quicksilver or black glue...
From this infinite variety the infinity of God the Creator can be seen as in a mirror.
If we view works thus, they are as mirrors of the man.
Enter into the mysteries of the Word... for its several Truths are so many mirrors of the Lord.
Like an image in mirrors...
Spirits could recognize themselves from my face in a mirror. Explained. SE 2205, Explained. SE 3019.
As in a natural mirror can be seen...
Into the focus of a burning mirror.
